Third-party dependency license list for React-related packages and libraries.

# Purpose
This file records third-party packages used by the application and the license terms that apply to each package. It lists package names, versions, license types, repository links, homepages, authors, and full license text where required, so the codebase can track legal notices and dependency provenance. The content covers React, routing, state, charting, UI, utility, and data grid libraries, which shows that the application depends on many external modules for user interface, data display, and browser behavior. It is used for compliance review, distribution, and audit work, and it helps ensure that the project includes the correct attribution and license notices for all bundled software.
